story_type: injured hiker hoisted in a litter off a loose lava rock ridge, rescuer rides the litter up
hook: Hurt on a ridge of loose lava rock, high in the Cascades.
narration: This hiker was hurt on a ridge of loose lava rock, high in the Oregon Cascades.
It was a lava field near North Sister, in the Three Sisters Wilderness.
Loose rock and steep ground made it too risky to carry anyone out on foot.
So a Coast Guard helicopter from Air Station North Bend came in overhead.
A rescuer went down on the cable, onto the rock below.
Next came a rescue litter. The patient is strapped flat inside it, so nobody has to climb back over the rock.
[short pause] Then the rescuer rode the litter up, spinning slowly under the rotors.
outcome: The Air Station North Bend crew hoisted the injured hiker off the lava field and into the helicopter.
title: Hoisted off a loose lava rock ridge
description:
On Sept. 5, 2026, a U.S. Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station North Bend hoisted an injured hiker from a lava field near North Sister, Oregon, where loose rock and steep terrain made a ground carry out too risky.
